item_sink.configuration.item_sink.values: First match wins. Use item ids, #tags, contains:phrases, namespace:modid or wildcards, then -> tier or -> outputItem, count, ticks, FE/t.

item_sink.ponder.item_sink_complete.head: Using and Automating the Item Sink
item_sink.ponder.item_sink_complete.text: Right-click the sink. Put unwanted items in its left input slot.
Turn the belts. Funnels feed accepted items from the input chest into the sink.
The extracting funnel puts currency on the output belt. Collect it in the chest.
Keep power supplied and the outputs clear. A full machine pauses until there is room again.
item_sink.configuration.item_sink.values: Selectors skipped by keywordRules only. Custom pricing rules and tier item lists still apply. Use excludedItems to block every source.
Enable keywordRules for automatic item detection. Custom pricing rules, tier item lists and fallback remain available.
Ordered keyword and regular-expression rules for material, form, machine and food names. First match wins beneath custom rules and tier item lists.
